Nutritional Deficiencies Related to Abnormal Assessment Findings in the Gastrointestinal 
System 
Abnormal findings in an assessment of the gastrointestinal system and other systems can indicate the presence of 
disease or nutritional deficit. To best plan nutritional strategies for the client, the nurse should know what each 
abnormal finding, in conjunction with laboratory results and dietary recall, could indicate. Some abnormal findings 
and nutritional deficiencies and toxicities related to them are shown in Table 17.4.
